description.zh: 资源ID。最多支持解绑20个资源ID。
description.en: The resource IDs. You can detach tags from a maximum of 20 resource IDs.
The resource type. Set the value to **ANYCASTEIPADDRESS**.

description.zh:
要解绑的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag keys that you want to detach. You can enter a maximum of 20 tag keys. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It also cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eipanycast untag-resources --resource-id aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --resource-type ANYCASTEIPADDRESS --tag-key FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eipanycast UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000' --TagKey.1 FinanceDept --ResourceType ANYCASTEIPADDRESS
